sections.text:
- Program: the **Learning Enrichment Center (LEC)**, also called the "Learning and Enrichment
 Center" on the same page. One-on-one and by request, for "students ages two through grade
 12". Services: Tutoring; Academic Coaching/Executive Function Support; Social Skills Groups
 (OT-led, 3-4 students, 30 min weekly); Speech-Language Therapy (contract with *Speech
 Techniques*); Occupational Therapy (contract with *Integrative Wellness*, "an additional
 service").
- Access: a request form, after which the Director of Learning Services, Dr. Chuck LaRusso,
 calls the family.
- Claimed NOT STATED: eligibility, documentation, 504/IEP handling, accommodations, specially
 designed instruction, reading method, screening, psychoeducational evaluation, testing
 accommodations, PT, school psychologist, **nurse**, **counselor (on the website)**, crisis
 resources, ESL, gifted program.
- Claimed: **no LEC fee published anywhere**; OT "an additional service" implies a charge.
- Counseling: cited a 2025 X post naming "ECH & LS Counselor Patience Perry" and an April
 2026 NAIS "Lower School Counselor" posting ("crisis interventions as needed").
- Admission tests: Gesell (JK–1), reading assessment + at-home ISEE (2–4), ISEE (5–12);
 $100 application fee; transcripts and teacher recommendations requested.
- Middle School: a study skills course every year; Upper School math and world language for
 students "ready to learn at the next level".
- Staff: the 13 people on the LEC page; claimed directory title conflicts ("Learning
 Enrichment Center Tutor", "Kindergarten Learning Specialist"); LaRusso also called "Director
 of Curriculum".
- Careers: a "Learning Specialist — Oct 1 2026" posting, later replaced by "Substitute
 Teacher — Oct 20 2026".
- The dossier's own scorecard: overall 4/10.

# Davidson Day School — Learning Support & Student Services — Official Site Research

fetching Davidson Day School's **own** pages directly (`curl` with a browser user agent, raw
HTML stripped to text), the Finalsite-hosted PDF the school links, the school's own LEC
request Google Form (linked from its LEC page), and Wayback copies of school pages that are
now 404. Per the area's rule, **only official school sources** are used: davidsonday.org,
its Finalsite resource-manager files, its staff directory, its own request form, and
web.archive.org copies of those. The user's Claude deep-research dossier (transcribed
alongside this file as `Davidson Day School - Learning Support - Deep Research.md`) was used
as a **lead sheet only**; every fact below was re-read on the live page or its Wayback copy.
Where the two disagree, the live site wins (see "Corrections to the deep-research dossier"
at the end).

No student is named in this file. The LEC page carries two parent testimonials attributed
only by grade ("Parent of 6th and 10th Grade Students"); no names appear.

sections.text:
The LEC is linked from the main navigation under both **Academics** and **Student Life**.

> The Learning Enrichment Center at Davidson Day School provides personalized, one-on-one
> instruction that supports students ages two through grade 12 as they pursue growth,
> confidence, and academic success. In partnership with families and classroom teachers, our
> tutors empower students to embrace challenges, take ownership of their learning, and
> develop the skills they need to thrive in school and beyond.
>
> Our individualized lesson plans are designed to meet the unique needs of each learner,
> honoring diverse learning styles and building independence. We specialize in academic and
> executive functioning support, as well as speech-language therapy and occupational therapy.

**Services Offered:** Tutoring · Academic Coaching/Executive Function Support · Social Skills
Groups · Speech-Language Therapy · Occupational Therapy

> **Tutoring** — LEC Instructors meet with students in a one-on-one setting for one or more
> sessions per week to provide review or remedial instruction in a specific subject area
> (Language Arts, Math, Science, Social Studies, and/or Foreign Language) or to address
> specific academic difficulties (reading fluency and comprehension or math skills).
> Tutoring is available to students at all grade levels.

> **Academic Coaching/Executive Function Support** — LEC Academic Coaches meet with students
> in a one-on-one setting, for one or more sessions per week to support and improve academic
> performance. Academic coaching is designed to help students develop organizational and time
> management skills, learning techniques, and self-advocacy. Classroom assignments may be
> utilized as training tools; however, Academic Coaching is more than ‘homework help’. It is
> a working relationship focused on the processes of learning. Students will likely have
> homework remaining after sessions. Academic Coaching is available to students at all grade
> levels.

> **Social Skills Groups** — Social Skills Groups are led and directed by an occupational
> therapist to focus on an array of social skills. … The focus of social groups will be to
> teach kids to interact appropriately with others, and to help kids learn conversational
> skills, problem-solving, and self-regulation in a group setting. Social Skills Groups will
> be made up of 3-4 students, grouped by age and goal areas. Sessions will last 30 minutes and
> meet weekly. Social skills groups include: Positive Peer Interactions · Taking Turns &
> Problem Solving · Cooperative Play · Expressing Feelings · Perspective Taking ·
> Understanding Non-Verbal Cues

> **Speech-Language Therapy** — Davidson Day School has a contract with Speech Techniques to
> provide speech-language services on campus during the school day. Speech-Language
> Therapists meet with students in a one-on-one setting, for one or more sessions per week to
> improve oral-motor competence, language processing and comprehension, and the skills
> necessary for effective communication with peers and adults. Speech-Language Therapy is
> available to students at all grade levels, with sessions typically lasting 30-minutes.

> **Occupational Therapy** — Davidson Day School has a contract with Integrative Wellness to
> provide occupational therapy services on campus during the school day as an additional
> service through the Learning and Enrichment Center. Occupational Therapists meet with
> students in a one-on-one setting for one or more sessions per week to improve handwriting,
> visual-motor integration, sensory processing, social skills, and other fine motor skills.
> Occupational therapy is available to students at all grade levels, with sessions typically
> lasting 30-minutes.

**FAQ (verbatim answers):**

> *How do I get my child a tutor in the LEC?* If you would like to request a Learning
> Specialist, please submit our request form. Director of Learning Services Dr. Chuck LaRusso
> will then call you to discuss the kind of academic support your child needs and what type
> of tutoring services are available. Together, we will find the Learning Specialist to match
> the needs of your child.
>
> *How are services delivered at the LEC?* Each Learning Specialist has his/her own private
> office in the LEC where he or she will meet one-to-one with a student. The environment is
> welcoming and is child-centered, outfitted with different types of seating, work spaces,
> dry-erase boards, and manipulatives to support learning.
>
> *How am I kept informed about my child's progress?* At the end of each week, you will
> receive an email from your child’s Learning Specialist. The specialist will give you an
> overview of the work that was completed during the tutoring session, what still needs to be
> completed, and possible home follow-up.
>
> *Why is the LEC preferable to an outside tutoring service?* When you partner with the LEC,
> your child’s tutoring is often done during the school day, often during a study hall
> period. This allows for flexibility after school to enable your child to take part in
> extracurricular activities. Additionally, the Learning Specialist will have direct contact
> with the classroom teacher/subject area teacher.

Links on the page: "Request Learning Enrichment Center Support | 2026-2027 School Year" (→ S2)
and "Connect with the Director of Learning Services".

sections.text:
Title: **"Request Learning Enrichment Support 2026-2027"**. Description, verbatim:

> Please complete this form if would like to request a one to one tutor or therapist through
> the Learning Enrichment Center (LEC). Once submitted, we will begin to work on matching
> your student with one of our excellent tutors. As we approach the first day of school we
> will share important LEC information, including our 2026-27 rates, and the assigned tutor
> will reach out to your family regarding their services.

Questions: student's first and last name; **Student's Grade** (options: Early Preschool,
Pre-School, Junior Kindergarten, Kindergarten, 1st … 12th); **"What type of LEC services are
your requesting? Check all that apply."** (options: Academic Tutoring · Executive
Function/Organization Tutoring · Personalized Exploration (Enrichment) focused on student's
passions and curiosities · Speech and Language Therapy · Occupational Therapy · Social Skills
Groups); subject if academic tutoring; "What are your goals for your child?"; "How many days
a week would you like your child to be seen?" (1–4 times a week).

**The form asks for no diagnosis, evaluation, 504 plan, IEP or other documentation.**

Rendered and checked against the image; the text layer is clean.

> Dear Davidson Day Families,
>
> The Learning Enrichment Center (LEC) at Davidson Day is excited to announce our Summer
> Tutoring and Therapy program, running from **Monday, June 1st, to Thursday, July 30th**.
> Sessions will be tailored to fit both student and tutor schedules, ensuring a personalized
> experience.
>
> Our summer offerings include individualized tutoring and/or therapy sessions designed to
> help your child maintain and enhance their academic skills. … our dedicated LEC tutors
> provide one-on-one support in a caring environment.
>
> … To request tutoring, occupational therapy, and/or speech and language therapy during the
> summer for your child, click here.

**Cost for Summer Tutoring (billed directly to your Patriot Account):**

| Service | Time | Cost (billed to Patriot Account) |
|---|---|---|
| Tutoring | 30 minutes | $47 |
| Tutoring | 40 minutes | $63 |
| Tutoring | 50 minutes | $78 |

> Additionally, we will offer occupational and speech and language therapy over the summer.
> Please see the fees below:

| Service | Time | Cost (billed to Patriot Account) |
|---|---|---|
| Occupational Therapy | 60 minutes | $160/session |
| Speech Therapy | 30 minutes | $80/session |

> If you have any questions about summer tutoring, please contact me directly at
> 704-237-5282 or via email at clarusso@davidsonday.org
>
> Sincerely, Chuck LaRusso, Director of Curriculum

These are **summer 2026** rates. **No school-year (2026-27) rate is published**; S2 says the
rates are shared with families "as we approach the first day of school". The summer OT
session is 60 minutes, where S1 says school-year sessions typically last 30 minutes.

sections.text:
1. **Counselors are named on the school's own site.** The dossier says "Its website pages also
 name no counselor" and leaned on a 2025 X post (Patience Perry) and an NAIS posting. The
 live directory lists **Laura Shea, Lower School Counselor** and **Jessica Thompson, Middle
 and Upper School Counselor**. No "Perry" is in the directory. Neither the X post nor the
 NAIS posting (robot-blocked) is used.
2. **A school nurse is listed.** The dossier says the nurse is NOT STATED on official
 sources. The directory lists **Angela Spraberry, School Nurse**.
3. **LEC fees ARE published, for summer.** The dossier says no LEC fee schedule is published
 on any official page. `2026SummerLEC.pdf` (S3), linked from the school's back-to-school
 page, lists tutoring at $47 / $63 / $78 (30 / 40 / 50 min), OT at $160/session (60 min)
 and speech at $80/session (30 min), "billed directly to your Patriot Account". The request
 form (S2) confirms 2026-27 rates exist and are shared before school starts. They are not
 published.
